title: Alert audiences, clearing, snoozing and recurrence
question: Who receives each alert type, and who may clear it for everyone? Does a cleared alert return when the condition recurs in a later capture? How do assignment, expiry and thresholds work?
context: Today snoozes are personal, while a manual clear is shared and suppresses the same condition in future captures. The UI asks users to clear an alert once it is addressed (PROG-REQ-041, PROG-REQ-042).
